Definition: to suspend or poise (especially in trade)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to weigh, weigh out, pay out; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to weigh; 1a2) to weigh out (a price); 1a3) of grief (fig); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be weighed; 1b2) to be weighed out
